not_extracted_but_relevant: This paper's actual NEW content is transition-state (TS1, TS2) geometries and decomposition-pathway energetics (IRC-confirmed dissociation barriers, NIMAG=1 saddle points) for N7+ -> N5+ + N2 (stepwise, via stable linear N5+) and N7- -> ... (concerted 2xN2 elimination for the C2 anion). These are NOT local-minimum structures and fall outside the scope of this structure-extraction pass (which targets stable isomers only), but are directly relevant to the 'kinetic stability / barrier height to dissociation' future-work item already flagged in the main report's roadmap (rapport_polyN_biblio.tex, item on TS/IRC as unexplored). Flagging here so the coordinator can revisit this paper specifically when/if a kinetic-stability study is undertaken. Key finding: 'N7 ions do not seem to be stable enough as a metastable species in a practical sense' (paper's own conclusion) -- i.e., low barriers to N2 loss for both the cation and anion global minima.
